diagnosis: CommercialLeadDetailView directly echoes the client's Origin header into Access-Control-Allow-Origin while setting Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to true. In addition, the query fetches CommercialLead solely by lead_id without verifying that the authenticated user's organization owns the lead. Any external site visited by an authenticated sales agent can read confidential commercial lead records across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/crm/leads/90481/ HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.businesscloud.io
Origin: https://malicious-tracker.org
Cookie: sessionid=active_agent_session
Accept: application/json
